name: ULTRASONIC CLEANER
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS Ultrasonic Cleaner (Bath Sonicator) uses 40 KHz ultrasonic sound waves to effortlessly remove biological particles from dental instruments and precision parts. Constructed with thick gauge SS 304, it includes a digital timer, digital temperature controller, and built-in generator.
features: 40 KHz ultrasonic frequency for deep, non-destructive cleaning
Digital timer (1 to 99 minutes) and digital temperature controller (up to 80°C)
Completely made of thick gauge stainless steel 304
Built-in generator with Semiwave and Degas functions
Compact tabletop design ideal for spaces with major size concerns
